text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит hasn't shown up for
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's strange, because she always fully
applies
herself to practice. Wondering if
something
happened, I hurry out to look
for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yaaay, I did it! I finally got it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I spot Ticket coming out of a sports
supply store
near the station.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the clerk was so kind. ♪ We
ended up
having a whole conversation!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You seem to be in a good mood!

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Well, yeah! I'm feeling
great!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You'll never guess why! You know my
favorite
cycling gear brand, Two-Five
Double?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Well, I managed to get my hands on one
of their
mega-premium items! ♪
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I've never been able to get one before,
but my
cycling buddy told me about this
sale!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
When I saw it in real life, it looked even
better
than I expected! Two-Five
Double gear really is
the greatest!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Gaaah! I totally forgot about it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I warn Уиннинг Тикит to pay more
attention next
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
